notes: Pokémon editor groundwork: the Gen 3 Edit save dialog now shows your Party — each Pokémon's level, name, shiny star, nature and IVs, read straight from the (decrypted) save. This is the read side of the new Pokémon editor; editing (shiny/IVs/moves, kept legal) and one-tap event Pokémon build on it next. The decryption was verified byte-exact against a real Emerald save.
